title: Changelog Watcher – Application updates
description: Versions in use vs. available versions per environment (bugfix/minor/major), aging and drift.

panels.title: % up to date
panels.description: Share of deployments (with a known version) running the latest version.

panels.title: Bugfix pending
panels.description: Deployments with a bugfix version (same major.minor) available.

panels.title: Average libyears
panels.description: Average, per deployment, of the gap in years between the version in use and the latest.

panels.title: Apps with divergent versions
panels.description: Applications running different versions across environments.

panels.title: Status by environment
panels.description: Largest pending update of each deployment.

panels.title: How long they have been outdated
panels.description: Outdated deployments by time since the first newer version was published.

panels.title: Average libyears
panels.description: Average libyears per deployment. The higher, the older the environment.

panels.title: Versions in use and available updates
Version comparison across environments
panels.description: One column per environment. Use it with the drift panel.

panels.title: EOL reached
panels.description: Deployments whose cycle in use is already unsupported (endoflife.date).

panels.title: EOL soon
panels.description: Deployments whose cycle in use loses support within the warning period (EOL_WARNING_DAYS).

panels.title: End of life of the cycle in use
panels.description: Cycle of each deployment according to endoflife.date and the days until its end of life (negative: already past).

panels.title: Versions published in the last 7 days
Last refresh
panels.description: Time since the end of the last refresh.
